ReferenceError CodesDLS / TLN / CFE Errors — Block 4xx

DLS / TLN / CFE Errors — Block 4xx

This page lists every platform error message registered in numeric block 4xx. Messages come from the message catalogue; HTTP status, handler, and spec provenance come from the error catalog where recorded. Explanation, likely cause, and recovery are curated for documented blocks and shown as — elsewhere.

DLS — Deals

401_DLS_COUNTERPARTY_CLIENT_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID

FieldValue
Error code401_DLS_COUNTERPARTY_CLIENT_RELATIONSHIP_INVALID
HTTP status422
MessageThe selected counterparty does not have a valid active relationship (Bank, FSP Trader, Supplier, or Customer) with the client. Please select a different counterparty.
ExplanationThe counterparty chosen for the deal has no valid active relationship with the client, so the deal cannot be confirmed.
Likely causeThe counterparty is not linked to the client as a Bank, FSP Trader, Supplier, or Customer, or that relationship is expired or inactive.
RecoverySelect a counterparty that holds an active relationship with the client, or ask an administrator to set up the relationship on the business partner records.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/validateCounterpartyClientRelationship.ts · spec 001 · DLS conductPreConfirmCheck

402_DLS_COUNTERPARTY_NOT_FOUND

FieldValue
Error code402_DLS_COUNTERPARTY_NOT_FOUND
HTTP status422
MessageA counterparty must be selected for this deal.
ExplanationEvery deal must name a counterparty, and this one does not.
Likely causeThe counterparty field was left empty, or the selected record was deleted before confirmation.
RecoveryChoose a counterparty from the value help list and save the deal again.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/validateCounterpartyClientRelationship.ts · spec 001 · DLS conductPreConfirmCheck

403_DLS_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND

FieldValue
Error code403_DLS_CLIENT_NOT_FOUND
HTTP status422
MessageThe selected client does not exist.
ExplanationThe client referenced on the deal does not exist in the system.
Likely causeThe client record was deleted, or the deal references an invalid or stale client identifier.
RecoveryRe-select the client from the value help list. If the client is missing, ask an administrator to create or restore the business partner record.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/validateCounterpartyClientRelationship.ts · spec 001 · DLS conductPreConfirmCheck

FieldValue
Error code403_DLS_SOD_VIOLATION
HTTP status—
MessageThe user who captured a deal cannot confirm it (segregation of duties).
Explanation—
Likely cause—
Recovery—
Source—

404_DLS_CLIENT_MUST_BE_BUSINESS_PARTNER

FieldValue
Error code404_DLS_CLIENT_MUST_BE_BUSINESS_PARTNER
HTTP status422
MessageThe selected business partner is not a client.
ExplanationThe business partner selected as the client is not classified as a client.
Likely causeThe partner exists but does not carry the client category, so it cannot be on whose behalf a deal is traded.
RecoverySelect a business partner that is flagged as a client, or have an administrator assign the client category to the partner.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/validateCounterpartyClientRelationship.ts · spec 001 · DLS conductPreConfirmCheck

405_DLS_SOD_CAPTURE_CONFIRM_SAME_USER

FieldValue
Error code405_DLS_SOD_CAPTURE_CONFIRM_SAME_USER
HTTP status403
MessageYou cannot confirm a deal that you captured. A different user must perform the confirmation.
ExplanationSegregation of duties blocks the confirmation: the user who captured the deal cannot also confirm it.
Likely causeThe same person performed the capture and is attempting the confirm step, which governance rule SoD-001 forbids.
RecoveryAsk a different user with the dealer or manager role to open the deal and confirm it.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal

406_DLS_DEAL_NOT_FOUND

FieldValue
Error code406_DLS_DEAL_NOT_FOUND
HTTP status404
MessageThe specified deal could not be found.
ExplanationThe deal the action is being performed on could not be found.
Likely causeThe deal was deleted, or the page is showing a stale link to a deal that no longer exists.
RecoveryRefresh the list and open the deal again. If the deal genuinely does not exist, verify the deal number with the originator.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal, cancelDeal

407_DLS_DEAL_NOT_IN_CAPTURED_STATUS

FieldValue
Error code407_DLS_DEAL_NOT_IN_CAPTURED_STATUS
HTTP status409
MessageThis deal is not in CAPTURED status. Only captured deals can be confirmed.
ExplanationOnly deals in captured status can be confirmed, and this deal is in a different status.
Likely causeThe deal was already confirmed, cancelled, or otherwise moved on by another action.
RecoveryRefresh the deal and check its lifecycle status. If it is already confirmed there is nothing further to do; if it was cancelled, capture a new deal.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal

408_DLS_DEAL_ALREADY_TERMINAL

FieldValue
Error code408_DLS_DEAL_ALREADY_TERMINAL
HTTP status409
MessageThis deal has already reached a terminal status and cannot be cancelled.
ExplanationThe deal has reached a terminal status such as settled, matured, or cancelled, so it cannot be cancelled again.
Likely causeA cancel action was attempted on a deal whose lifecycle is already complete.
RecoveryNo cancellation is possible. If the settled position must be unwound, use the reversal or termination process instead of cancel.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS cancelDeal

409_DLS_CONTRACTUAL_TERMS_LOCKED

FieldValue
Error code409_DLS_CONTRACTUAL_TERMS_LOCKED
HTTP status409
MessageThe contractual terms of this deal are locked after confirmation. Field(s) affected: {1}.
ExplanationThe contractual terms of a confirmed deal are locked and cannot be edited; the message lists the fields that were touched.
Likely causeAn update changed one or more locked contractual fields after the deal was confirmed.
RecoveryEdit only the fields that remain open after confirmation. To change locked terms, cancel before confirmation or use rollover or termination after confirmation.
Sourcesrv/deals/validation.ts · spec 002 · DLS before UPDATE

410_DLS_NO_CATEGORIES_CONFIGURED

FieldValue
Error code410_DLS_NO_CATEGORIES_CONFIGURED
HTTP status422
MessageNo accounting event categories are configured for this deal type and occasion.
ExplanationThe confirmation cannot complete because no accounting event categories are configured for this deal type and occasion.
Likely causeThe accounting definition for the instrument or occasion has not been set up for the company.
RecoveryAsk a system administrator to configure the accounting event categories for this deal type and occasion, then confirm the deal again.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal

411_DLS_CATEGORY_PROCESSOR_NOT_FOUND

FieldValue
Error code411_DLS_CATEGORY_PROCESSOR_NOT_FOUND
HTTP status422
MessageNo accounting processor is registered for the category ‘{1}’.
ExplanationAn accounting event category was resolved for the deal, but no processor is registered to handle it.
Likely causeThe category is configured but the matching accounting processor is missing or misconfigured.
RecoveryContact a system administrator to register or correct the processor for the category, then retry the confirmation.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal

412_DLS_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION

FieldValue
Error code412_DLS_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION
HTTP status409
MessageThis deal was modified by another user. Please refresh and try again.
ExplanationAnother user changed the deal while this action was in progress, so the change was rejected to protect against overwriting.
Likely causeTwo users had the same deal open and saved conflicting changes.
RecoveryRefresh the deal to load the latest version, reapply the intended change, and try again.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS confirmDeal

413_DLS_GL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND

FieldValue
Error code413_DLS_GL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND
HTTP status500
MessageThe general ledger account could not be found.
ExplanationThe posting pipeline could not find the general ledger account needed for this deal.
Likely causeThe account mapping for the financial node is missing, or the referenced account was removed.
RecoveryAsk an administrator to configure or restore the general ledger account mapping, then retry the confirmation.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS executePostingPipeline

414_DLS_GL_ACCOUNT_CLASSIFICATION_MISSING

FieldValue
Error code414_DLS_GL_ACCOUNT_CLASSIFICATION_MISSING
HTTP status500
MessageThe general ledger account has no classification assigned.
ExplanationThe general ledger account found for the posting has no classification assigned, so the pipeline cannot determine how to post it.
Likely causeThe account was created without a general ledger account classification.
RecoveryAsk an administrator to assign a classification to the account, then retry the confirmation.
Sourcesrv/deals/utils.ts · spec 002 · DLS executePostingPipeline

415_DLS_ACTING_CAPACITY_INVALID

FieldValue
Error code415_DLS_ACTING_CAPACITY_INVALID
HTTP status—
MessageInvalid acting capacity {1}. Must be OWN_BOOK, ON_BEHALF, or AGENCY.
ExplanationThe acting capacity recorded on the deal is not one of the allowed values.
Likely causeThe field was set to a value outside own book, on behalf, or agency — for example through an import with a typo.
RecoverySet the acting capacity to one of the three valid values and save again.
Source—

415_DLS_NO_CLOSING_LEGS

FieldValue
Error code415_DLS_NO_CLOSING_LEGS
HTTP status422
MessageAt least one closing leg is required for a rollover proposal.
ExplanationA rollover proposal must close at least one leg of the existing position, and none were provided.
Likely causeThe rollover was proposed without selecting any closing legs.
RecoveryAdd at least one closing leg to the rollover proposal and submit again.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/rolloverValidation.ts · spec 003 · DLS proposeRollover

416_DLS_NO_OPENING_LEGS

FieldValue
Error code416_DLS_NO_OPENING_LEGS
HTTP status422
MessageAt least one opening leg is required for a rollover proposal.
ExplanationA rollover proposal must open at least one new leg, and none were provided.
Likely causeThe rollover was proposed without defining any opening legs.
RecoveryAdd at least one opening leg with valid terms to the rollover proposal and submit again.
Sourcesrv/reuse-functions/rolloverValidation.ts · spec 003 · DLS proposeRollover

416_DLS_ON_BEHALF_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_OPERATING_MODEL

FieldValue
Error code416_DLS_ON_BEHALF_NOT_ALLOWED_FOR_OPERATING_MODEL
HTTP status—
MessageOn-behalf acting capacity is not permitted for your company’s operating model.
ExplanationThe company’s operating model does not permit trading on behalf of clients, so the on-behalf acting capacity is rejected.
Likely causeA treasury-only operating model was used for a deal that carries the on-behalf capacity.
